source.quote: Additions to content assets ( 17,096,617 ) ( 16,223,617 ) ( 12,554,703 ) Change in content liabilities ( 610,838 ) ( 779,135 ) ( 585,602 ) [in thousands; 2025, 2024, 2023]

ecosystem.notes: Netflix has no volume measure, so measure is null. The FY2025 10-K no longer states a total for payments for content assets in MD&A, so payouts uses the cash-flow line 'Additions to content assets' ($17,096,617 thousand); the separate 'Change in content liabilities' outflow ($610,838 thousand) is not added. Netflix classifies both within operating cash flows. The figure covers both licensed content and content Netflix produces itself ("We acquire, license and produce content, including original programming"), so it is not all money paid to outside partners.
